title: agentkeel verdict history
description: Security (SPEC/07 section 6; SPEC/06 section 9 cut 1, received at M07). Panel 2 is the verdict history: one row per envelope on main, with its commit, the verdict it stores and the mode it ran in, read through Athena's DynamoDB connector from the table agentkeel-envelopes and nothing else. The verdict is the run's own, as stored: a GREEN here is not a ledger row's reading (the envelope for 245eb9b stores GREEN and row 6 is RED; docs/platform/surfaces.md). validate refuses a panel 2 target that computes a column, filters on the verdict, or reads any other table (src/validate/panel.py). Imported into the workspace by hand; the data source uid 'registry' is the workspace's one Athena data source, whose catalog holds both tables.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT commit, verdict, mode FROM "agentkeel_registry"."default"."agentkeel-envelopes" ORDER BY commit
